title: AI Engineer - Visual LLM and Agentic AI
reason: Stack +52; Title fit +12; Title stack +8; US +10
description_preview:
About Strayos
Strayos builds visual AI technology for mining and heavy-industry operations. Our platform transforms data from drones, cameras, LiDAR, field sensors, equipment, and geospatial systems into accurate digital twins and decision intelligence across the mine-to-mill value chain.
We work on problems where AI must perform beyond a controlled laboratory environment. Data is large, multimodal, spatial, imperfect, and collected under changing field conditions. The systems we build must be accurate, explainable, production-ready, and useful to engineers and operators making consequential decisions.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an
AI Engineer — Visual, Agentic & Geospatial AI
to help build the next generation of Strayos intelligence products. This role sits at the intersection of
Visual Language Models, computer vision, agentic AI, 3D digital twins, geospatial computing, and Physical AI datasets
.
You will develop AI systems that can understand imagery, video, maps, point clouds, site models, documents, and operational data; reason across these inputs; call the appropriate vision and geospatial tools; and return trustworthy, actionable results. You will also help create the datasets, evaluation systems, and production infrastructure required to make these capabilities reliable in real-world industrial environments.
This is an applied engineering role for someone who enjoys moving between research, data, software, and product—and who measures success by what works for customers in production.
What You Will Do
Visual LLMs and multimodal AI :
Adapt, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy vision-language and multimodal foundation models for visual question answering, grounding, classification, detection, segmentation, change analysis, report generation, and spatial reasoning
Agentic computer vision :
Create agents that plan multi-step visual workflows, select and call computer-vision or geospatial tools, maintain context, verify intermediate outputs, quantify uncertainty, and involve a human when confidence is insufficient.
Digital-twin intelligence :
Develop models and algorithms that reason over orthomosaics, terrain and surface models, meshes, point clouds, LiDAR, raster and vector layers, and time-series site captures
Physical AI datasets :
Design data-collection and labeling strategies for models grounded in real sites, sensors, machines, and environmental conditions. Establish annotation ontologies, quality controls, lineage, versioning, privacy and safety practices, and representative evaluation sets.
Production AI systems :
Build modular training and inference pipelines, APIs, batch and streaming workflows, model registries, observability, rollback paths, and cloud or edge deployment strategies. Optimize latency, memory, throughput, reliability, and cost without compromising measurable quality.
What You Will Bring
Applied AI delivery :
You have built and shipped computer-vision, multimodal, or Visual LLM systems beyond prototypes, and you can explain how quality was measured after deployment
Modern model development :
You are highly proficient in Python and modern deep-learning frameworks, especially PyTorch. You understand transformers, vision-language models, multimodal embeddings, model adaptation, retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, and systematic evaluation.
Computer vision :
You have practical experience in several areas such as detection, segmentation, tracking, metric learning, OCR, multimodal fusion, image and video understanding, or 2D/3D reconstruction.
3D and geospatial data :
You have worked with one or more spatial representations such as point clouds, meshes, LiDAR, orthophotos, digital elevation or surface models, raster and vector layers, coordinate systems, or spatial databases.
Technical foundations :
You bring strong applied problem-solving skills in linear algebra, probability and statistics, optimization, and 2D/3D geometry and working knowledge on RGB, video, thermal, multispectral or hyperspectral cameras, LiDAR, GNSS/IMU, IoT sensors, drones, scanners, or heavy equipment.
What Success Looks Like
Within your first year, you will have shipped customer-facing multimodal or agentic AI capabilities; established measurable evaluation baselines; improved the quality, coverage, and reuse of Physical AI datasets; and contributed reusable components that accelerate future Strayos products. You will be trusted to move from an ambiguous field problem to a well-scoped technical approach, a validated model, and a monitored production system.
Why Join Strayos
You will work on AI problems that connect digital intelligence to the physical world. The role offers the opportunity to combine modern foundation models with computer vision, 3D geometry, geospatial data, digital twins, and industrial domain expertise—and to see that work influence real operational decisions.
You will have meaningful ownership across the full AI lifecycle: problem definition, data strategy, research, evaluation, production deployment, and continuous improvement. You will work with a collaborative, globally distributed team that values practical innovation, technical rigor, and customer impact.

Experience designing and executing intrinsic, extrinsic, and temporal calibrations, along with sensor characterization under real-world environmental conditions.

SoloPulse Corp is a dual-use radar company committed to the relentless exploration of the frontiers of radar sensing technology. Located in Atlanta, GA, SoloPulse stands as a venture-backed startup, diligently cultivating strategic collaborations to proactively address critical safety imperatives and emerging autonomy needs across both civilian and military domains. Our distinguished team encompasses accomplished engineers, seasoned advisors, and experienced startup veterans, collectively driven by an overarching mission to change the way the world sees.
SoloPulse is seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the operator-facing software for our radar systems. Our sensors output detections, tracks, and imagery products at high rates, and users need to work with that output in real time, often on limited hardware and unreliable networks. You will build the web applications they use, along with the integrations that carry our output into the systems they already run, including TAK and customer C2 and autonomy platforms. You will work with radar and embedded engineers on the data contracts behind the product and with end users on the workflows in front of it.

Design and build production web applications for real-time RF output visualization, including live detections and tracks, spectrogram displays, geospatial overlays, and post-mission playback and review
Own features end to end, from problem framing and interaction design through implementation, field validation, and iteration
Engineer for performance at high data rates: streaming ingest, efficient rendering, memory discipline, and smooth interaction on modest field hardware
Define and shape the APIs and data contracts between the frontend and our embedded and backend systems, in partnership with the teams that build them
Build and maintain integrations that deliver SoloPulse detections and tracks into the systems our users already operate, including TAK (ATAK, WinTAK, iTAK, and TAK Server) over Cursor on Target, along with customer C2, autonomy, and ISR platforms
Own the interoperability layer end to end, including standards-based message formats, publish and subscribe interfaces, and the adapters, plugins, and SDKs that let partners and integrators consume our data
Partner with integrators and government end users during integration events and demonstrations, and turn what breaks in those environments into durable product improvements
Work directly with operators, test engineers, and customers to translate real workflows into features, and validate that what shipped actually works for them
Establish frontend fundamentals as the product grows, including component architecture, testing, build and release tooling, telemetry, and error reporting
Support field testing and deployments, including on-site debugging of the full stack from sensor to screen
Collaborate with a broad range of cross-functional teams including radar, embedded software, hardware, program management, and senior leadership
Qualifications
At least a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or other technical field, or equivalent practical experience
6+ years of professional frontend application development experience, preferably on data-intensive, visualization-heavy, or mapping products
Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React
Expert-level proficiency in Android-platform development technologies (Kotlin, Java, Android Studio)
Demonstrated track record of shipping production interfaces that users depend on, and owning changes and maintenance after launch
Working knowledge of backend web services and API design; comfortable reading and contributing to the services your interfaces consume
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance
Nice-to-Have
Experience with browser graphics programming (WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, or a rendering library built on them) for large or continuously updating datasets
Experience with real-time, high-performance DSP or sensor data visualization (waterfall displays, spectrograms, radar or sonar imagery)
Experience with mapping and geospatial visualization stacks (Mapbox GL, deck.gl, Cesium, or similar)
Hands-on experience with the TAK ecosystem: ATAK/WinTAK plugin development, TAK Server deployment or federation, Cursor on Target message design, or data package workflows
Familiarity with interoperability and messaging standards used across defense and autonomy systems, such as STANAG 4676, ASTERIX, MISB/KLV, KML and GeoJSON, MQTT, ROS 2, or MAVLink
Experience with Dart and Flutter, or a comparable cross-platform framework, for building tablet and handheld clients that run alongside our web applications in the field
Experience with browser streaming technologies (WebSockets, WebRTC, WebTransport) and binary protocols such as Protobuf or FlatBuffers
Experience with multi-threaded browser development using Web Workers, WASM, or SharedArrayBuffer
Experience developing and maintaining reusable TypeScript libraries or internal design systems
Experience building software for defense, aerospace, autonomy, or other operational environments
Join our team and be part of a dynamic, collaborative environment where innovation and creativity thrive. MuleSoft Senior Developer- Enterprise
Overview
You are a self-driven individual with a “get it done” attitude and a passion to solve complex business and technology problems. You enable integrated business processes across applications that share common data elements using scalable and proven design patterns and techniques (e.g., integrating Salesforce and an ERP system). You enjoy working in agile teams to deliver API-led integration solutions and are excited to learn and integrate to new business applications.
What You’ll Do
Work with Architects to translate business requirements into well-designed integration solutions
Participate in technical design sessions and develop detailed technical solution documentation that is aligned with client business objectives
Develop, test, and document integration solutions and data migration elements of business applications in the CRM, ERP, and/or HCM domains
Provide detailed estimates and work breakdown structure for assigned tasks
What You’ll Bring
Ability to program in object oriented and/or functional programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, etc.
Familiarity with cloud-based and on-premise enterprise applications such as: NetSuite, SAP, Oracle ERP, Salesforce, Dynamics AX/CRM, Workday, etc.
Understanding of Webservices standards and technologies such as: WS*, JSON, REST, GraphQL etc.
Understanding of structured and/or unstructured databases and data models like MS SQL, My SQL, Postgress, Mongo DB, Hadoop, etc.
Experience in delivering real-time, event-driven, and batch integration solutions
Background in data architecture, design, and data modeling
Understanding of cloud computing and micro-services architectures
Strong problem solving and software triage skills with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced and rapidly changing work environment
Demonstrated skills in helping negotiate priorities and resolving conflicts among project stakeholders (such as customers, product management, and engineering)
Knowledge of QA processes and test-driven development
Familiarity with agile software delivery methodologies such as Scrum
A background in large integration projects with large and multi-sourced data sets is a definite asset

MuleSoft Senior Developer- Enterprise

You are a self-driven individual with a “get it done” attitude and a passion to solve complex business and technology problems. Work with Architects to translate business requirements into well-designed integration solutions

Develop, test, and document integration solutions and data migration elements of business applications in the CRM, ERP, and/or HCM domains

Familiarity with cloud-based and on-premise enterprise applications such as: NetSuite, SAP, Oracle ERP, Salesforce, Dynamics AX/CRM, Workday, etc.
Understanding of Webservices standards and technologies such as: WS*, JSON, REST, GraphQL etc.
Understanding of structured and/or unstructured databases and data models like MS SQL, My SQL, Postgress, Mongo DB, Hadoop, etc.
Experience in delivering real-time, event-driven, and batch integration solutions
Background in data architecture, design, and data modeling
Understanding of cloud computing and micro-services architectures
Strong problem solving and software triage skills with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced and rapidly changing work environment
Demonstrated skills in helping negotiate priorities and resolving conflicts among project stakeholders (such as customers, product management, and engineering)
Knowledge of QA processes and test-driven development

title: Robotics Autonomy Engineer-Planning and Control - Federal
reason: Stack +28; Title fit +6; Exp fit +10; US +10; Overqualified -45; Senior salary -45
description_preview:
Who are We?
Field AI
is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications.
Learn more at
https://fieldai.com.
About the Job
Field AI is building the future of autonomy, from rugged terrain to real-world deployment. We are on a mission to develop intelligent, adaptable robotic systems that operate beyond simulation and thrive in unpredictable environments.
As our
Robotics Autonomy Engineer – Planning and Control
, you will design, implement, and deploy advanced motion planning and control algorithms that enable our robots to move with precision, robustness, and efficiency across diverse environments. You will work on navigation, trajectory generation, and motion control for robotic platforms ranging from wheeled and legged systems to complex humanoid architectures. If enabling robots to navigate challenging, dynamic environments excites you, and you want to work where your code works in the physical world - this is your role. This is Field AI.
What You’ll Get To Do
1. Develop Robust Motion Planning Algorithms
Design, develop, and refine motion and navigation planning algorithms for challenging real-world scenarios such as narrow passages, dynamic obstacles, and complex environments.
Design optimization-driven approaches for path and trajectory generation that ensure smooth, reliable, and efficient robot navigation across modalities.
Ensure scalability, reusability, and adaptability of planning approaches across diverse deployment contexts.
2. Advance Control and Planning Integration
Develop and tune control algorithms that ensure precise trajectory tracking and stable operation across different robotic systems.
Collaborate across autonomy layers to ensure seamless coordination between perception, planning, and control for robust real-world performance.
3. Validate and Test Across the Stack
Build and maintain testing pipelines from unit-level validation to full robot deployment.
Utilize simulation and testing environments for algorithm evaluation, benchmarking, and regression validation.
Analyze real-world telemetry to diagnose issues, identify improvements, and enhance algorithm robustness.
4. Diagnose and Improve Field Performance
Investigate and resolve issues arising from field deployments through structured data analysis and debugging.
Deliver targeted improvements that address specific challenges while maintaining general-case reliability and performance.
What You Have
PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 2+ years of industry or applied research experience or MS degree in a related field with 4+ years of relevant experience, or BS degree in a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience.
Strong understanding of motion planning, trajectory generation, and control systems.
Experience developing algorithms for one or more robotic systems (wheeled, legged, wheeled-legged, humanoid).

title: Senior Space Mission Software Engineer
reason: Title disqualified: Senior Space Mission Software Engineer
reject_reason: Title disqualified: Senior Space Mission Software Engineer
description_preview:
About Varda
Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules.
Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.
From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.
Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.
Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.
Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.
About This Role
The
Senior Mission Software Engineer
is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.
Responsibilities
Own Ground Segment Services: Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.
Mission Control Interfaces: Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.
Simulation and Test Automation: Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.
Build the Mission Platform: Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.
Deployments Across Environments: Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.
Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.
Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.
End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.
Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.
Preferred Skills And Experience
Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.
Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).
Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.
Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.
Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.
Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.
Pay Range
Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.
This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

The organization operates in the healthcare and life sciences sector, addressing the challenge of extracting value from unstructured medical data. Serving leading institutions in healthcare, life sciences, and research, the organization supports faster studies, improved insights, and enhanced patient care. It is backed by a publicly traded parent company and focuses on positioning structured data as a foundation for innovation.
2. About the Opportunity:
The AI Engineer is responsible for enhancing the quality and efficiency of the clinical data platform. This applied-AI role requires versatility across software engineering, data science, experimentation, and production operations. The position focuses on analyzing the effects of pipeline changes on system performance and implementing improvements across model interactions, information retrieval, workflow control, and output validation. The role contributes to making AI systems measurably better and turning experiments into real product capabilities.

• Develop software programming paradigms for platform interactions with LLMs under different token usage scenarios
• Build evaluation frameworks to assess cost-performance trade-offs of various language models relevant to core workloads
• Collaborate with clinical experts to encode domain knowledge and establish quality standards
• Create test suites measuring accuracy, completeness, consistency, latency, and cost
• Design controlled experiments to assess effects of platform changes
• Enhance model interactions through prompting, structured outputs, tool integration, context management, and workflow design
• Develop datasets and internal tools for evaluation, regression testing, and rapid iteration
4. Requirements:
• Minimum 5 years of experience in applied machine learning, AI engineering, data science, or related software engineering roles

• Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and refined technical taste

About ActAI
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.
Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.
Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.
About the Role
As an ML Platform Engineer, you will build the infrastructure and systems that power ActAI's AI capabilities.
You will design and operate the systems behind the AI stack, from model training and evaluation to deployment, inference, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product engineers to turn models into reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production systems. You will build the platforms, tooling, and infrastructure that enable the team to experiment quickly and bring AI capabilities to production with confidence.
Focus
Build and operate the ML infrastructure and platforms powering A1’s AI products
Design systems for model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, and experimentation
Build and optimise model serving and inference infrastructure for high-throughput and low-latency workloads
Improve reliability, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency of AI systems
Develop reliable pipelines for data preparation, training, evaluation, model release, and continuous improvement
Build platforms and tooling that enable AI engineers and researchers to experiment, evaluate, and ship models faster
Develop evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure to measure model quality, performance, and regressions
Build production observability, monitoring, tracing, and alerting for AI/ML workloads
Improve AI systems across reliability, scalability, latency, throughput, and cost

Work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product teams to turn evolving model requirements into production-ready infrastructure

Python
PyTorch / JAX
LLM and ML serving infrastructure such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM
Cloud infrastructure
Distributed systems
ML/data pipelines and workflow orchestration
GPU infrastructure and performance tooling
Vector databases and retrieval infrastructure
Ideal Experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems
Experience building ML infrastructure, platforms, or production machine learning systems
Experience with model deployment, inference, evaluation, or data pipelines

Ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code

AI infrastructure reliably supports production workloads at scale
